augment_text_with_zero_width: create an InsertionAugmenter with zero_width char_type and call augment on text to insert invisible characters
augment_text_with_punctuation: create an InsertionAugmenter with punctuation char_type and call augment on text to insert random punctuation
augment_text_with_whitespace: create an InsertionAugmenter with whitespace char_type and call augment on text to insert whitespace characters
insert_chars_per_word: use InsertionAugmenter with word granularity to insert characters within each word of the input text
insert_chars_with_varying: create an InsertionAugmenter with vary_chars true to insert different random characters at each insertion point
